name: John Marinopoulos
qualifications: Masters of Science in Mathematical Statistics
FAMSRS - Fellow of the Australian Market and Social Research Society
expertise: Strategic Land Use Planning and Analysis
bio: John Marinopoulos is an advisor to governments and the private sector on resilient infrastructure, disaster risk reduction, cities and precincts to understand and realise the value and benefits from planning and delivery of infrastructure. John has over 30 years of experience in delivering strategic analyses and assessments to drive performance. Specific areas of expertise include resilient infrastructure assessment, financial modelling, quantitative modelling, strategy development, econometric analysis, market and customer research and analysis, risk assessment, stakeholder and reputation management and large scale project management.

John is also the co-program lead for the Enabling Resilience Investment Framework. John was one of the driving forces behind the creation, development and implementation of the ERI approach and guidance. See https://research.csiro.au/enabling-resilience-investment/, and https://research.csiro.au/enabling-resilience-investment/tools-products-services/guidance/.
Outside work, you can find John with a camera in his hand taking photographs of nature, wildlife and landscapes, striving to capture unique moments.

name: Nic Mesic
expertise: Strategic Land Use Planning and Analysis
bio: Nic Mesic is an advisor to government and the private sector on cities and precincts to maximise the value and benefits from the timely planning and delivery of infrastructure and the pathways to infrastructure financing and funding. Nic has over 25 years' experience in senior roles in consulting and advisory services, business strategic planning, communications and marketing. In these roles Nic has worked with Boards, CEO's, senior executives, government officials and community leaders to design, develop and implement business growth and productivity initiatives in both the private and public sectors.

Nic is also the co-program lead for the Enabling Resilience Investment Framework. Nic was one of the driving forces behind the creation, development and implementation of the ERI approach and guidance. See https://research.csiro.au/enabling-resilience-investment/, and https://research.csiro.au/enabling-resilience-investment/tools-products-services/guidance/.

Outside the office Nic has a great passion and interest in music (listening, not playing unfortunately), which has spawned some great days and nights of live shows. At home, a wave of gardening is consuming his spare time, though you're unlikely to see him invited to share any tips or advice on Gardening Australia.

name: Peter Heinmiller
qualifications: Planning Institute of Australia (PIA) Allied Professional Member
expertise: Dynamic Dashboard Design and Data Visualisation
Strategic Land Use Planning and Analysis
bio: Peter combines his academic background in organizational psychology with his professional experience in complex data and analytics to unlock insights for clients in the areas of infrastructure planning and funding, precinct planning, renewal and strategy, transport options analysis, development scenario assessments, and economic strategy and frameworks.

He has a strong understanding of the city shaping role of infrastructure and how its planning, investment, delivery, and maintenance can drive social, economic, and environmental outcomes to improve the lives of the people who live, work and play in these places. Peter has designed, developed and applied sophisticated models and decision tools for input into business cases, strategic assessments, technical reports, strategy and government papers, particularly in the context of value creation and value capture.
Outside work, you can find Peter playing (and collecting) guitars, playing ice hockey, or relaxing on the beach with his family.

name: Christopher Marinopoulos
qualifications: LSE Executive Education Course - Cities: Governance, Planning and Design
Planning Institute of Australia Full Member (MPIA)
bio: Chris has eight years of experience in both strategic urban planning and architectural roles in Victoria. His involvement in both precinct development, urban renewal projects and economic assessments shows a wealth of knowledge to many facets of the built environment.
He provides strengths in analytical approaches to built form, precinct development, policy analysis, mapping including GIS and urban planning knowledge.
Outside work, you can find Chris exploring Melbourne for new restaurants and cafes, weekends away camping and enjoying a round of golf.

name: Dylan Pleiter
expertise: Dynamic Dashboard Design and Data Visualisation
bio: Dylan is a data analyst who manages VAP's analytics and interactive visualisation capabilities. Currently completing a Master of Data Science, Dylan brings a range of technical capabilities to VAP including modelling, advanced analytical techniques, machine learning, database management, and application development.

Having worked in consulting for over 9 years, Dylan has experience working on a range of projects across the economy, from large scale infrastructure projects to smaller market insight studies. During that time, Dylan has focused on progressing reporting from static documents to a more dynamic experience that allows clients to interact with the data and query results based on a range of assumptions.
Outside work, you can find Dylan running & cycling, with his book club or playing beach volleyball.
